title: Fix native review bindings, resident I/O and validation coverage
body:
This PR integrates the Rust runtime and repairs native review delivery, resident transport and storage admission. Noncommand reviews bind to the selected enforcing acknowledgment; migration 29 preserves their scope alongside the original receipt table, and approval consumption remains atomic. Installed behavior and the remaining qualification gaps are documented in the linked source-bound evidence.

Current implementation: [`4afa20cf014ccba918bf2fa61552dafe66767930`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/4afa20cf014ccba918bf2fa61552dafe66767930), tree `0f924adeb6501adb22f68f82f1c20b9a6e945513`, parent `2ac6b1bd`. This concurrent change carries the caller's absolute Rust deadline through discovery and exchange, rejects otherwise-successful responses after late lease cleanup, preserves earlier fatal errors and adds five real-socket regressions. It preserves the predecessor's retirement fix (`exitcode` instead of nonexistent multiprocessing `poll()`). Results below retain the exact source that ran; predecessor results are not reassigned to this new head.

- Workspace observations share the captured acceptance-time origin; the original 400 ms readiness limit and independent full-startup timing remain explicit.
- The public scanner function loads on first access while retaining function identity, model exports, discovery, concurrent access and reload behavior. Scanner import side effects occur at first scanner access.
- Failure reports retain finite delivery facts and writer counters. Failure capture requires the current diagnostics contract, uses explicit failure-code branches, and retains the original probe exception if diagnostic collection fails.
- Native receipt binding, atomic approval consumption, storage checks and the bounded macOS socket handling remain in place. The CLI test file and its 49 named partitions meet the actual review limit: at most 344 nonblank lines, with a maximum of 421 physical lines.
- RSP-100 request-local risk reuse and a permission-preserving Windows reader repair remain under isolated validation. The new managed deadline implementation is being reconciled with the additional Unix pre-connect fence and stronger boundary controls. Final combined-source validation and original acceptance remain incomplete.

The [complete PRD](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/PRD.md), [all 144 original tasks with current actions](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/TODO.md), [Takeaway](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/TAKEAWAY.md), [current observations](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/LATEST-RESULTS.md) and [evidence inventory](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/EVIDENCE.md) are now published in `aba7420f`. The packet contains 145 verified files totaling 18,114,021 bytes. The original four documents, all 144 whole task objects, all 119 catalog objects, every acceptance criterion and dependency clause, and archived statuses are preserved; no task is promoted by publication.

The [independent publication peer and interpretation correction](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c9485244e69ef35f2f23b249a12e3063fe45b6d0/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T071300Z-publication-readback/CORRECTION.md) clarify that twice-derived risk describes current behavior: the original once-only requirement remains the implementation target, with authority, callback and 5 ms freshness guards preserved. Earlier evidence commits remain unchanged. [Availability notes](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/AVAILABILITY.md) identify bytes lost when the primary workspace disconnected and the later recovery sandbox was replaced. Surviving logs and peer records do not restore missing original artifact members. The exact private “Resume Rust PRD” chat was unavailable; these documents use the preserved Git originals and recovered records without claiming access to unrecovered messages.

| Evidence scope | Verified result and practical limit |
| --- | --- |
| Predecessor `4d107`, focused diagnostics validation | 121 tests and six separate import-boundary controls passed under Python 3.12.10. Changed-file lint, format and diff checks passed; the focused type check reported zero errors and 228 warnings. Earlier source validation remains scoped to its original commit. |
| Predecessor `4d107`, normal four-platform native-wheel run | All four jobs are terminal success. Linux completed 100,000 responses and 250,000 receipts, zero request/health failures, 21,378 health checks and one stable daemon; request p95 was 568.87 ms and RSS growth 3.7746%. Both Macs processed 21 native receipts, but ARM/Intel concurrency-16 p99 values of 298.514/704.768 ms exceed the original 200 ms target. Windows also reports one `all_evidence: journal_checkpoint/os_permission` failure despite an empty native-receipt failure map. These ordinary job successes do not establish full qualification. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35492742680). |
| Predecessor `4d107`, Ubuntu transport | Two initial policy pushes failed before the spoof/slow-client and overload scenarios began: 13 tests passed and two failed. `native_resident_live_request_failed` does not identify the internal cause or prove a timeout. A separate same-source integration job passed its 16 controls under different setup/order, which does not resolve this failure. [Failed job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35492742596/job/106030357811). |
| Predecessor `4d107`, corrected native validation | Run `35493601886` remains failed. The original rows now independently reconcile 29 Python cases/87 phases, six producer-fixture cases/18 phases and 24 Rust entries. At workspace count 1, registration/policy ACKs were 112.306/84.153 ms with one matching committed receipt each. Retirement observation then raised `AttributeError`: its fixture called `poll()` on a multiprocessing worker. The home was not removed, replacement was unconstructed and counts 10/100 were unvisited. Original process-group retirement does not certify complete descendants. The bounded decoder verified 111/114 members; three large inventory/admission records remain unadmitted. The separate retirement repair passed its strict hosted gate in run `35496733388` and was published as predecessor `2ac6b1bd`; that successor does not erase this failure. [Original run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35493601886), [decoded original records and source peer](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/b69f5e44eb2371586bb6b4a313b65c58b2897e96/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T073813Z-decoded-native/README.md). |
| Predecessor `2ac6b1bd`, retirement repair | Existing run `35496733388`, job `106040961917`, is now independently reconciled: 29 Python cases/87 phases, six separate producer-fixture cases/18 phases, 24 distinct Rust tests, and three actual-output consumers. All nine installed 1/10/100 registration/policy/re-registration ACK observations meet 400 ms (85.333–197.415 ms), with exact matching native/SQL receipt objects. All 707 ledger records reconstruct 93 checksummed packets; six service instances retire and 12 retained workers are reaped with exit code -9. This is not graceful shutdown or complete escaped-descendant certification. The bounded reader admits 111/114 members; three large inventories remain excluded. Original construction, Python-process restart, lost hints, key/expiry/rollout and full qualification remain outside this diagnostic. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35496733388), [decoded original records](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/171dac1f9a7728b7ac260ce8af4458341f773692/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T090200Z-terminal-and-retirement/worker-retirement-decoded/AUDIT.json). |
| Predecessor `4d107`, corrected supplemental validation | The original report is now independently reconciled: **634 distinct cases, 1,902 passed setup/call/teardown rows, 634 matching JUnit cases, zero skips/xfails**, with 298 disjoint ordered selectors across ten physical cohorts/eight groups. The original 593 and separate 41 remain distinguished. All 216 member names/172 content values and selected source/AST bindings were verified. The reader's initial Python 3.13 AST-serialization mismatch, explicit correction and controls remain retained. This reads existing run `35494533524`; it does not rerun tests or establish complete descendant/performance qualification. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35494533524), [decoded evidence](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/e866aed949d057fbc1ef59e3e0d127007107377b/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T082000Z-verified-supplemental/supplemental634/AUDIT.json). |
| `0a6` 349-case and `d1ba` 276-case earlier cohorts | The first passed 349 cases/1,047 phases; the second passed 276 cases/828 phases and all 21 parent commands. The 23,294-node collection was collection only. Each result remains bound to its earlier source and retains earlier failed attempts. [349 run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35488738407), [276 run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35491137938). |
| `d1ba`, prior failed supplemental/native attempts | The first 593-case attempt passed 340 cases/1,020 phases; 253 bodies were unrun after Cartesian-index admission failed. The earlier native attempt passed prerequisites/build/install but failed both installed inventories at an optional uv archive-hash assumption; its 1/10/100 diagnostic was unrun. These original failures remain retained. [Supplemental](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35490801471), [native](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35490641762). |
| `8f15`, six-case Windows reader control | All six cases executed once with cleanup. Four no-held/released cases passed; the two held-destination cases returned original WinError 5 instead of the frozen expected 32, so both case gates and the job remain failed. No predicate was relaxed. The original artifact bodies are now unavailable, but the full job log, source/driver and exact peers survive. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35493953456). |
| `8f15`, separate Windows source/destination role control | Both tests passed their scope: a held destination produced original WinError 5; a held temporary source produced original WinError 32, followed by verified reader retirement and separate after-release positives. This establishes distinct handle-role behavior, not the identity of the historical normal-job holder or a product repair. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35494547182). |
| `8f15`, prior normal/observer/paired cohorts | The normal Linux soak passed; the normal Windows startup failed at auth-token replacement with WinError 32. The observer later committed all 603 observed native receipts, but only 598/600 hook bindings were complete and RSS rose 15.3487% against 12%. The paired Mac and Linux records still miss original acceptance/resource/rollback gates. Later successes do not erase these source-specific failures. [Full retained observations](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/aba7420f54eaa658d0422f09b08767a030317de8/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T065000Z-surviving-records/CURRENT-RESULTS.md). |

The completed `2ac6b1bd` census contains 187 checks: 167 success, 19 skipped and one Kilo review failure reporting rate limiting. All four normal native jobs passed. Linux completed 100,000 responses and 250,000 receipts with zero request/health failures, 21,246 health checks, stable PID, request p95 570.57 ms, maximum 718.43 ms and RSS growth 3.5436%. Linux c16 p99 was 633.602 ms; Mac ARM/Intel were 501.140/846.008 ms. Those ordinary smoke results use their original 1,000 ms ceiling and do not meet the PRD's 200 ms qualification target. Windows and both Macs each processed 21 native receipts with empty printed failure maps. Sonar passes on exact `2ac6b1bd`; Gitleaks reports zero leaks across the full 1,348-commit base-to-head range. The separate current-at-that-time Ubuntu edge cohort passed 15 tests. All 59 threads were resolved, but all 51 formal reviews were COMMENTED, with zero APPROVED and `deep-purple-boots` requested. These remain predecessor facts after the PR advanced to `4afa20cf`; fresh final-head review and genuine CODEOWNER/last-push approval remain required. [Terminal evidence and exact original log](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/171dac1f9a7728b7ac260ce8af4458341f773692/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T090200Z-terminal-and-retirement/normal-2ac-terminal/AUDIT.json), [independent source/log peer](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/171dac1f9a7728b7ac260ce8af4458341f773692/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T090200Z-terminal-and-retirement/normal-2ac-peer/).

The isolated deadline formatting job passed on driver `c62531b6`: all ten source images are idempotent, both source/driver checkouts remain clean, and all 46 projected source/result/error bodies were independently verified from the original log. Production-core images did not change during formatting. Actual isolated validation is separate: Linux run `35500586815` reproduced all four expected failures on the instrumented before source and passed all nine controls on candidate `54fff0b4`. Both Macs and Windows in that first run stopped at unavailable Python setup, before Rust execution; the source-identical three-platform setup correction is [run `35500925728`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35500925728). The candidate and concurrent `4afa20cf` source remain distinct. Formatting alone is not a runtime repair result. [Formatting evidence](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/e866aed949d057fbc1ef59e3e0d127007107377b/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T082000Z-verified-supplemental/deadline-formatting/deadline-rustfmt-result/verification.json).

The [new terminal/retirement appendix](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/171dac1f9a7728b7ac260ce8af4458341f773692/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T090200Z-terminal-and-retirement/README.md) retains 114 verified files totaling 4,590,217 bytes, both independent 634-case peers, the original second Linux diagnostic lint failure, earlier PR readback and a [complete updated 144-task action overlay](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/171dac1f9a7728b7ac260ce8af4458341f773692/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T090200Z-terminal-and-retirement/task-status-overlay.json). Every original task identity, acceptance clause, dependency and archived status is preserved; no task is promoted.

The original comparison baseline remains `2e672d2d950c6ec471005ddba46e49bba16dc23b`. Full acceptance still requires the original installed routes/control coverage, matched-host sample populations, latency and complete process-resource limits, selected implementation work, signing and frozen-artifact checks, actual update/downgrade/rollback evidence and authorized canary work. The stopped E/F campaigns remain immutable and inactive. No source test, internal peer review, ordinary smoke success or document publication supplies full performance qualification.

Implementation, full qualification, independent approval, activation and release remain incomplete. The [prior PR description](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/c9485244e69ef35f2f23b249a12e3063fe45b6d0/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T071300Z-publication-readback/PR-before.md) and earlier evidence history remain available for review.
